answer: A fixed newcomer pool caps what fresh identities can win. Every identity younger than 50 epochs splits one pool worth 5% of each epoch's rewards (assumed figure), however many newcomers exist. Spinning up 500 clones doesn't widen that pie; it slices the same thin plume of tokens into 500 crumbs, most paid back to the farm itself. Reaching the full-reward summit takes 50 epochs of peer-attested work, so the ivory tower of established agents grows at the pace of honest effort, not of keygen.
